question: Find the acute angle between the line $\vec{r}=(\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k})+\lambda(2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k})$ and the plane $x+2y+2z=6$.
explanation:
Step 1: Direction vector and normal vector
The direction vector of the line is
$$\vec{b}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k},$$
while a normal vector to the plane is
$$\vec{n}=\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+2\hat{k}.$$
Step 2: Angle-between-line-and-plane relation
If $\phi$ is the acute angle between the line and the plane, then
$$\sin\phi=\frac{|\vec{b}\cdot\vec{n}|}{|\vec{b}||\vec{n}|}.$$
Step 3: Scalar product
$$\vec{b}\cdot\vec{n}=2(1)+(-1)(2)+2(2)=4.$$
Step 4: Magnitudes and substitution
$$|\vec{b}|=\sqrt{4+1+4}=3,\quad |\vec{n}|=\sqrt{1+4+4}=3.$$
Thus,
$$\sin\phi=\frac{4}{9}.$$
Step 5: Final result
Therefore, the acute angle between the line and the plane is
$$\phi=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{4}{9}\right).$$
